content: Claimed bd-hkw5.3 (cross-project coalitions). Plan: (1) CoalitionManifest gains member->project map (intents/reservations already project-scoped in mailbox); (2) form accepts per-crew project slugs, validates members registered in their own project; (3) declare_intent/reserve/negotiate route per-member to their project; (4) status fans intent/reservation views across member projects; (5) disband releases reservations in BOTH projects; (6) hermetic e2e test: crews from two projects, intents scope per repo, disband cleans both. Touching flywheel/src/coalition.rs + main.rs only.
